responsibility: Carries the vendored Rust community code-of-conduct text for the embedded rustc-hash dependency used in the Polonius support stack. Its role is purely upstream project governance documentation for contributors and moderation, with no effect on GCC compilation, borrow-check analysis, hashing behavior implementation, or diagnostics generation.
same_name_distinction: This CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md belongs to the vendored rustc-hash crate in vendor/rustc-hash/, not the datafrog crate; within the same-name group, its distinction is solely that it accompanies the hashing dependency rather than the Datalog engine dependency.
